head_commit.message:
ci(build): add production build leg + DF-9ROUTER-47 repro evidence

The build leg itself landed in 4a8aa053 (.github/workflows/tests.yml, job
`build:` lines 33-89: npm ci, npm run build with NODE_OPTIONS=--stack-trace-limit=50,
fatal artifact assertions on .next/BUILD_ID and the standalone outputs).
This commit adds the missing dated evidence record and re-verifies at the
current HEAD ba55b7f9:

- Part 1 repro attempt: 10 cold-cache builds (1 main-tree + 3 rounds x 3
  concurrent in independent repo copies), loadavg up to ~22/16 cores,
  NODE_OPTIONS=--stack-trace-limit=50 on every build. 10/10 rc=0, distinct
  BUILD_IDs, zero uncaughtException/TypeError markers. The 2026-09-25 crash
  did NOT reproduce (20 builds across two HEADs including the prior 10x run in
  4a8aa053); recorded as honest non-reproduction — it is load/concurrency
  dependent and its original stack was hidden by Next's ignore-listed filter.
- Part 2 leg verification: YAML parses (jobs test/build/e2e); the leg's exact
  commands run green locally at HEAD (exit 0, BUILD_ID=fx1fTgSjSlXPRhFyC3ecD,
  all four artifact assertions pass).

Evidence: docs/dogfood/df47-2026-10-08-repro.md

Co-authored-by: Alexis Okuwa <wojonstech@gmail.com>
